summary: FASE P6 frontend testing completed. Tested CSV export with scope dialog, dropdown standardization (KNSelect), and regression testing across 10+ screens. CSV files verified with UTF-8 BOM, semicolon separator, and correct row counts. Found one pagination issue on general-ledger journal tab.

ui_bugs.issue: Next button click does not change page - stays at 'Hal 1 / 6' and rows don't change
ui_bugs.reproduction: 1. Navigate to ?view=general-ledger, 2. Click next button on pagination bar, 3. Page indicator stays at 'Hal 1 / 6' and rows don't change
ui_bugs.expected: Page should change to 'Hal 2 / 6' and display next 20 rows
ui_bugs.actual: Page stays at 'Hal 1 / 6', same rows displayed

passed_tests: USER STORY 1: CSV scope dialog appears with correct buttons ('Halaman ini — 20 baris' and 'Semua hasil filter — 105 baris') and cancel button
USER STORY 1b: CSV file downloaded with '_semua_' in filename, UTF-8 BOM present (ef bb bf), semicolon separator, exactly 106 lines (1 header + 105 data rows matching pagination total)
USER STORY 1c: Page scope CSV downloaded with '_halaman_' in filename, exactly 21 lines (1 header + 20 data rows)
USER STORY 2: CSV export respects search filter (tested on orders with 'SO-' search)
USER STORY 3: Single-page lists skip dialog (tested on suppliers with 8 items - dialog skipped, file downloaded directly with '_halaman_' in name)
USER STORY 4: Notification center type filter is KNSelect (button element, not native select) with correct aria-label='Filter jenis notifikasi'
USER STORY 5: Zero native <select> elements found on 4 tested screens (general-ledger, orders, suppliers, customers-crm)
REGRESSION 2: Zero console errors across all screens visited
REGRESSION 3: No blank screens or React error overlays on: general-ledger, orders, suppliers, customers-crm, inventory, inventory-lots, vendor-bills, purchase-returns

notes: The floating 'Bantuan & Panduan' help widget at bottom-right is a known pre-existing issue (mentioned in review request). Worked around with scroll_into_view_if_needed + force clicks.
Entity mode defaults to 'Semua Entitas' which is VIEW-ONLY by design - this is correct behavior, not a bug.
All CSV files use Indonesian column names (e.g., 'No Jurnal', 'Tanggal', 'Sumber') and Indonesian date format (dd/mm/yyyy) as expected.
CSV files use comma for decimal separator (e.g., '1200000' not '1,200,000') which is correct for Indonesian Excel with semicolon column separator.
